mapper.select: SELECT max(tfm.ID) id, tfm.MIX_AREA, tfm.GLUE, GROUP_CONCAT( tlm.MACHINE_NAME ORDER BY tfm.machine_order SEPARATOR ',' ) AS MACHINE_NAME, GROUP_CONCAT( tfm.MACHINE_CODE ORDER BY tfm.machine_order SEPARATOR ',' ) AS MACHINE_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT( tfm.machine_order ORDER BY tfm.machine_order SEPARATOR ',' ) AS MACHINE_ORDER, max( tfm.remark ) remark, max( tfm.CREATE_TIME ) CREATE_TIME, max( tfm.del_flag ) del_flag, max( tfm.create_by ) create_by, max( tfm.update_by ) update_by, max( tfm.UPDATE_TIME ) UPDATE_TIME FROM t_formula_machine tfm inner join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tlm on tfm.MIX_AREA=tlm.MIX_AREA and tfm.MACHINE_CODE=tlm.machine_code where tfm.del_flag = '0' and tfm.mix_area = #{mixArea} and tfm.glue=#{glue} GROUP BY tfm.MIX_AREA, tfm.GLUE

select DISTINCT tfm.MIX_AREA, tfm.GLUE, tfm.MACHINE_CODE, tfm.MACHINE_ORDER, tmm.MACHINE_NAME from t_formula_machine tfm inner join ( select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' AND (mid_status = '0' OR night_status = '0' OR day_status = '0') union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' ) tmm on tmm.MACHINE_CODE = tfm.MACHINE_CODE and tmm.MIX_AREA = tfm.MIX_AREA where tfm.del_flag = 0 and tfm.mix_area = #{mixArea} and tfm.glue = #{glue}

SELECT M.MACHINE_CODE, M.MACHINE_NAME FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE M ON M.MACHINE_CODE = R.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE WHERE R.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = #{glue,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND R.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea,jdbcType= VARCHAR} GROUP BY M.MACHINE_CODE, M.MACHINE_NAME ORDER BY MACHINE_NAME
